title: Slam Dunk
interpretation: Independent original concept, explicitly authorized by management in the continuation request; not a faithful recreation or recovered design.

inputs.original_prompt: PROMPT.md preserved byte-for-byte (86 bytes). Its only content is the Google AI Studio footer; there is no remix link or usable design brief.
inputs.reference: The specified own reference image is absent; no reference or other design was accessed.
inputs.catalog_brief: Slam Dunk; Hero Section/landing; a Slam Dunk basketball themed hero with dynamic basketball elements and passionate sports styling.

creative_choices: Warm off-white, charcoal, court terracotta, and bright orange evoke street basketball and printed sports posters.
Condensed heavyweight headline, oversized outlined 23, hand-drawn-style SVG underline, court markings, and typographic ticker establish energetic sports styling.

The hero ball is original SVG geometry with gradients, a repeating pebble pattern, clipped seams, and CSS float/shot animation. The hoop, grid, brand mark, shadows, stars, and court lines are original SVG/CSS.
23 is a generic decorative jersey number. Coordinates are decorative geographic notation, not a promised venue or affiliation.
All marketing copy, fictional sessions, initials, and community values were written for this concept. Initial circles are graphic placeholders, not real player portraits or testimonials.
Interactions include a local session filter and reservation plan, three shooting fundamentals, community principles, basketball shooting with a score, and optional synthesized sound.
EST. 2026 denotes creation of this concept, not a historical organization. No actual team, league, event organizer, or anime affiliation is claimed.

assets.source: Authored in this project; no recovered art, reference extraction, generated raster images, or external image assets.
Google Fonts, locally bundled TTF files

assets.license: ISC; package license included with installed dependency

limitations: Fictional sessions only. Saving a spot stores a demo preference in browser localStorage, never a real booking.
No backend, account, AI service, external runtime API, deployment, or message sending.
Shot audio is synthesized with Web Audio after explicit opt-in; unavailable audio is silently optional.
Visual and browser verification uses local Chromium; no cross-browser or physical-device certification.
